================================================================================
Ordinary keyword use after an operand
================================================================================
(value) match {}
---
(program (match_expression (operand (identifier))))

================================================================================
Reserved immediate keyword remains valid in member syntax
================================================================================
value.match {}
---
(program (dot_match (identifier)))

================================================================================
Reserved immediate keyword followed by a separate identifier
================================================================================
value.match box
---
(program (dot_match (identifier) (identifier)))

================================================================================
Non-reserved immediate keyword with explicit precedence
================================================================================
value.keyword box
---
(program (dot_keyword (identifier) (identifier)))

================================================================================
Retained immediate prefix preserves a valid delimiter
================================================================================
value.other(box)
---
(program (dot_keyword (identifier) (identifier)))

================================================================================
Reserved keyword prefix is allowed in a definition name
================================================================================
def matcher = value
---
(program (definition (identifier) (identifier)))

================================================================================
Reserved keyword prefix is allowed in a definition value
================================================================================
def value = matcher
---
(program (definition (identifier) (identifier)))

================================================================================
Reserved keyword cannot be a definition name
:error
================================================================================
def match = value
---
(ERROR (ERROR) (identifier))

================================================================================
Reserved keyword cannot be a definition value
:error
================================================================================
def value = match
---
(ERROR (identifier))

================================================================================
Reserved immediate keyword cannot split a longer word
:error
================================================================================
value.matchbox
---
(ERROR (identifier) (identifier))

================================================================================
Other immediate keyword cannot split a longer word
:error
================================================================================
value.keywordbox
---
(ERROR (identifier) (identifier))

================================================================================
Reserved status does not permit whitespace before an immediate keyword
:error
================================================================================
value. match {}
---
(ERROR (identifier) (identifier))

================================================================================
Reserved keyword cannot be a member receiver
:error
================================================================================
match.match box
---
(ERROR (ERROR) (identifier))

================================================================================
Whitespace prevents a non-reserved immediate keyword
:error
================================================================================
value. keyword box
---
(ERROR (identifier) (identifier) (identifier))

================================================================================
Reserved status does not permit a newline before an immediate keyword
:error
================================================================================
value.
match {}
---
(ERROR (identifier) (identifier))
